text_block_list.text:
When I went looking for Super Creek, who 
didn't show up for training—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Phew. That should keep the button from 
popping off again~

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Now, what else was I asked to get...?
choice_data_list: Were you asked to do some sewing?
Were you asked to do some sewing?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. What brings you here...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Aah!? Is it really that late already... 
!?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer. I just got totally 
carried away...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I am truly sorry for causing you so 
much trouble.

After consoling a remorseful Super Creek, 
I left the classroom.
